entries.value: Standard damage (x1.0). The default stance: no weak points, but no outstanding strengths.
+50% damage to shear unstable masses. -50% against armor and rock, where the blade bounces off miserably.
+50% damage to shatter bones and metal. -50% against gelatinous bodies, which simply absorb the impact.
+50% thrust damage to vital organs and sap. -50% against wraiths: trying to pierce the wind is foolish.
+50% damage disrupting astral entities. -50% on raw flesh and plants, whose life force rejects this type of resonance.
+50% targeted annihilation on The Square entities. -50% against everything else. Devastating on its target, suicidal if used blindly.
